meta.title: Create an Article and a Menu Item
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Create an Article and a Menu Item".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Create an Article and a Menu Item', 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item', '

In this tour you add a web page to your site: you create an article and then a link to it in the Main Menu, so visitors can find it.

For example an article Company Overview and a menu item About Us that shows it.

This tour follows the tutorial 2.1 Creating an Article and Menu Item of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_menus"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 2.1 Creating an Article and Menu Item', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Create a new article', '

This is the list of all articles of your site.

Click New to start a new article.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Give the article a title', '

Type a title for the article, for example:

Company Overview

The title is shown at the top of the page and in lists of articles. When you have typed it, click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Write the article text', '

Type the text of the article in the editor, for example:

We are a company dedicated to providing quality products and services to our customers.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

Joomla saves the article and takes you back to the list of articles.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Your article is saved', '

Your new article is now in the list. It is published, but visitors cannot find it yet: no menu links to it.

Next, you add a link to it in the Main Menu.

', 7, 'bottom', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Menus', '

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 8, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Menus › Main Menu', '

Click Main Menu in Menus.

', 9, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'The Main Menu', '

This list holds the links of the Main Menu of your site.

', 10, 'bottom', '#menuitemList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Create a new menu item', '

Click New to add a menu item to the Main Menu.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-items .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Give the menu item a title', '

Type a title for the menu item, for example:

About Us

This is the text of the link in the menu. When you have typed it, click Next.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-item #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Choose the Menu Item Type', '

The Menu Item Type says what the link shows.

  1. Click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Articles, then Single Article.

The page reloads. When the field shows Single Article, click Next.

', 13, 'bottom', '.input-group:has(#jform_type)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Choose the article', '
  1. At Select Article, click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click the article you just created.

When the field shows the title of your article, click Next.

', 14, 'bottom', '.input-group:has(#jform_request_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Save the menu item', '

Click Save & Close.

', 15, 'bottom', '.view-item #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-create-article-and-menu-item'), 'Well done!', '

Your menu item is now in the Main Menu.

Look at your site: click the button with your site\'s name in the header at the top (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar). Click your menu item in the Main Menu to see your article.

', 16, 'top', '#menuitemList tbody tr:last-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
